purpose: Self-contained, hash-pinned source payload for the Alchemist Lab project to import through its established stock-first CAM packaging pipeline.

approved_versions.cast: renderer V20 / review V6 thrown potion
approved_versions.special: renderer V31 / review V7 single drink
approved_versions.death: V36 midpoint-corrected custom fall and reach

stock_authority.rule: Clone the complete stock action descriptor lifecycle and privateize only art references. Preserve headers, pointer ordering, count words, metadata, flags, attachments, repetitions, timing, cancellation, and cleanup.

visible_palette_contract.packaging_requirement: Append one private SPLT after the complete retail palette table; patch private TILE palette references without changing decoded visible indices.

requirements: Generate engine shadow controls during packaging; the Soft-B PNGs contain visible body art only.
Every grounded frame must have an index-247 seam touching the lowest six visible body rows.
No transparent moat may separate body and projected shadow bands.
No magenta-only band may touch body without the seam.
Visible and control pixels must be encoded in separate TILE-v3 RLE runs.
No control pixel may touch a TILE edge.

walk.packaging: Retain exact decoded indices and exact north-to-northwest, frame-00-to-frame-07 ordering; patch only the palette reference, add grounded controls, append private tiles, then remap the cloned private IMAG.

stand.packaging: Use the same approved alpha-128 palette mapping and grounded-shadow encoder already used by the current Walk/Stand test profile.

attack.choreography: Conventional forward-grip dagger thrust with the dagger in the anatomical right hand.
attack.packaging: Clone Warrior Attack literally and replace only its private tile references. Do not mirror a whole pose or change descriptor order.

cast.choreography: Throw one potion at the enemy; E and F preserve the empty-hand return so the bottle does not pop back.
cast.packaging: Do not infer a sequential shared-slot mapping. Rebuild the private descriptor from the copied raw-stock authority and topology reconciliation, retaining all seven occurrences and stock metadata while allowing private occurrence art.

special.choreography: One continuous drink: bottle rises once, head tilts back, bottle may be occluded by the head in rear views, then arm and head return naturally.
special.packaging: Preserve the stock seven-occurrence descriptor lifecycle, metadata, flags, attachments, and timing; give each occurrence its approved private art reference.

death.choreography: Recoil, buckle and release dagger/potions, fall, then lie reaching for the green potion before the grave replaces the body.
death.packaging: Use the approved action-wide common stock-derived padded canvas. Do not squeeze these poses back into per-frame Warrior rectangles and do not add custom frame offsets.

dead.packaging: Use this exact selected B crop as the single shared Dead frame; do not regenerate or reinterpret the design.

allowed_changes_in_import_thread: Teach the existing approved bundle loader to consume this local handoff root.
Extend the private ALC1 TILE/IMAG remap to the approved actions using copied stock topology.
Build only into the repository dist test directory, then deploy through the project's established launcher/deploy pipeline after validation.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not run the legacy generated-art cache for an approved sprite build.
Do not overwrite retail TILE slots or begin a private table before the complete retail table ends.
Do not invent action timers, polling, controllers, or alternate lifecycle descriptors.
Do not reuse the Phantom floating-shadow offset/clearance algorithm for this grounded hero.
Do not package control-review PNGs, APNGs, GIFs, comparison sheets, or high-resolution renders.
Do not mutate or deploy directly from this handoff directory.

payload_integrity.canonicalization: Sort payload-relative paths ordinally; one UTF-8 line per file as lowercase_sha256, two ASCII spaces, path, LF; include final LF.
